_comment: Canonical model-tier table. domains/dev/config/pi/models.json, dsh/settings.yaml's local-proxy provider block, and litellm/config.yaml's model_list are all generated from this file by jig (`src/domain/tiers/` + `bun src/cli/jig.ts apply`, run from domains/dev/llm/harness/jig). Edit THIS file, then `jig apply`; never hand-edit a generated file directly except inside dsh's settings.yaml `# BEGIN jig:tiers` / `# END jig:tiers` markers, which jig also refuses to touch by hand once it owns them. Decision record: writeup store yoki/2026-09-16-observability-proxy-litellm; unified in the harness-parity plan, Phase 2.

_comment.baseUrl: confirm /v1 vs bare :4000 against the running proxy
_comment.compat: localhost gateways: pi-ai treats an unknown URL as OpenAI itself and sends fields LiteLLM may reject — these two are the usual fixes and have no UI field, so they must live here.
_comment.pi.apiKey: resolved at auth time by proxy-key.sh (headless: Keychain service-account token -> op read), so pi never triggers a 1Password desktop approval per message. Absolute path = personal-repo convention. Same op item the proxy uses.

_comment.apiKeyEnv: the PROXY master key, injected via `op run` (never on disk)

_comment.name: dsh's hand-written comment still calls this route Astra (gpt-6-astra); litellm/config.yaml actually routes `complex` to deepseek/deepseek-v4-pro today (see that file's own comment on the swap) — pre-existing drift this schema records rather than silently resolving.
